authorization: 你把递归关了还怎么验证RLM？换适合递归的任务，做启用递归和禁用递归的公平对照，继续查清为什么没有质量提升。仍用gpt-6.1-sol high，累计不要超过522次。

prior.policy: Historical aggregate is retained, not reconstructed into invented individual request identities. New ledger records only added calls; cumulative counters add this verified prefix.

fairness: Within each task, identical input bytes/task/output schema/tools/budgets/runtime/model. Only original native maxDepth changes; native capability and child-system scaffolding differences are retained and disclosed. No forced decomposition or host-supplied answer.
stopRule: Each of four conditions once. No failed-condition replay, new task selection, optional stopping on a favorable answer, paid fallback, or extra credits. If S has no actual child model call, it is capability-enabled evidence only, not observed recursive-effect evidence.
